name: V-Guard Industries Ltd
title: V-Guard Industries Ltd - 532953 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 revenue +14.1% and EBITDA +19.3% on volume, but FY26 EBITDA margin fell to 8.8% from 9.2%; ~75% of an 8–13% input-cost pass-through landed, with the balance pending as high-cost inventory arrives.

triggers.label: Price hikes ~75% landed
triggers.quote: We have probably landed about 75% of what price increases are required so far
triggers.highlight: landed about 75% of what price increases are required

triggers.label: EBITDA margin at least 10% (FY27)
triggers.quote: I wouldn't say 11%, 12%, I would say at least 10% is what we would like to expect there.
triggers.highlight: at least 10% is what we would like to expect

triggers.label: Wires entrant + lighting peers entering
triggers.quote: one more big player is entering this segment end of this year
triggers.highlight: one more big player is entering this segment

triggers.label: TPW fan stockouts, no channel inventory
triggers.quote: neither we have inventory nor our partners have inventory and we are having stockouts
triggers.highlight: neither we have inventory nor our partners have inventory

triggers.label: Summer weak in non-South; April mixed
triggers.quote: Non-South, it's been a mixed bag.
triggers.highlight: Non-South, it's been a mixed bag

guidance.quote: we strive to grow between 10% to 12% in volume and there is a 1% to 2% price growth culminating into 15% growth
I wouldn't say 11%, 12%, I would say at least 10% is what we would like to expect there.
this year we should have a good growth in Consumer Durables because of the low base effect

red_flags.label: Channel finance on ~35% of debtors
red_flags.quote: approximately 35% of our business goes through channel financing arrangement
